--- original

@@ -0,0 +1,44 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '80'
+title: 'ToolCallWitness: MountSite reports the start of each mounted call, outer and inner'
+---
+Request from foundationmodelsrouter-75, for acpagent-a5. The Router wants to hint a root session to hand a bug fix to an agent. In the bench, the model edits through runCode → tools.files.edit. Those inner calls go through ToolContext.mount, so the Router's decorator never sees them. It only sees the outer runCode call. The Router owns all the state and the hint. Extras gives only the seam. The change must be additive: existing callers compile without change.
+
+API, in Sources/FoundationModelsExtras/Hosting (HostingSeams.swift or a new ToolCallWitness.swift):
+```swift
+public protocol ToolCallWitness: Sendable {
+    /// Called once at the start of each call mounted on a site that carries this witness.
+    func toolCallWillBegin(_ call: WitnessedToolCall)
+}
+public struct WitnessedToolCall: Sendable {
+    public let tool: String          // the tool name
+    public let op: String            // the op of the site, or the tool name when the site has none
+    public let arguments: GeneratedContent?  // when Arguments is ConvertibleToGeneratedContent, else nil
+    public let sessionID: ULID       // the session of the site
+    public init(tool:op:arguments:sessionID:)
+}
+```
+
+- [ ] MountSite gets a stored `callWitness: (any ToolCallWitness)?`. Add a `callWitness: (any ToolCallWitness)? = nil` parameter to BOTH public inits (the root one and the child one), and pass it through the private init.
+- [ ] `posting(to:sessionSink:op:)`, `held(by:settlingBy:)`, `settling(within:)` and `postingToSession` keep the witness, because they copy self. That way each inner call made through ToolContext.mount reports to the same witness. A test proves this.
+- [ ] `MountSite.childSite(sessionID:runPlane:sink:)` (and so `ToolContext.childSite`) does NOT inherit the witness: the child gets nil. Document this.
+- [ ] Fire the witness exactly once per call, before the call runs, at the two entry points:
+  - `ToolMounting.call(_:arguments:site:mount:)` (ToolMounting.swift:380), which covers String tools, background and run-to-completion.
+  - `ContextBindingTool.call(arguments:)`, which covers tools whose output is not String.
+  - Check that no path fires it twice: MountRunner.call → ToolMounting.call is one path.
+- [ ] The call is synchronous and never blocks. The witness never changes, delays or fails a call. Firing happens before any run or lease opens, and the call result is unchanged.
+- [ ] The arguments are `(arguments as? any ConvertibleToGeneratedContent)?.generatedContent`.
+- [ ] Doc comments in the style of the file. Mention the seam in the makeWrapped doc and in the ToolContext.mount doc.
+- [ ] Tests (Swift Testing, new file Tests/FoundationModelsExtrasTests/Hosting/ToolCallWitnessTests.swift), with a recording witness (Mutex or a lock-backed class):
+  - an outer call on a root site reports once, with tool, op (the site op, else the tool name), arguments and sessionID;
+  - a run-to-completion tool and a background tool each report once;
+  - a non-String tool (ContextBindingTool) reports once;
+  - an inner call through ToolContext.mount inside an outer call reports with the op it was mounted with and the same sessionID, so the outer and inner calls give 2 reports in order;
+  - a childSite gives no report unless the child site gets its own witness;
+  - a site with no witness behaves as before (the existing tests stay green);
+  - a call whose tool throws still reports once, and the error is unchanged.
+- [ ] Full `swift test` is green with zero warnings, apart from the known Swift Build metal warning (see ^8pa1503).
+- [ ] After done: push to origin/main, then send the sha and the final API to foundationmodelsrouter-75.
\ No newline at end of file
